items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: Her name was Irma Keene something. I don't know. I'll tell you what. She probably live in Nama. Crown Lett and Louisiana Avenue... She used to live in that particular house.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's somebody I know I've forgotten about. I know I've met him once and we didn't really talk. I saw him once. He plays guitar pretty well.

Yeah, very good. And he sings very well. He sings very well. He's pretty good. He sings very well. He ideas for me. I don't know. We couldn't get the band together, so I never see him about it anymore. But he do sing very well. Do you know his real name? Does he go in there? No. I really don't. They call him Slim. I believe they call him Slim. I don't know what his real name. I really don't. I don't know. So he'd probably be around 20, 21? Probably at that age. He should have another brother. He should have a…
Did he tell you anything about his life before in Mississippi? What he did in Mississippi?
